title: Afflux
summary: AF'FLUX, noun [Latin affluxum, from affluo. See Flow.] The act of flowing to; a flowing to, or that which flows to; as, an afflux of blood to the head.

inlines.v: AF'FLUX, noun [Latin affluxum, from affluo. See Flow.] The act of flowing to; a flowing to, or that which flows to; as, an afflux of blood to the head.
